policy.palace: Use permanent loci for durable ecological identities, mechanisms, causal relationships, model structures, and exact terms that benefit from stable spatial retrieval.
policy.embedded: Embed tightly related definitions, examples, symbols, and mechanism details inside the locus that carries their governing ecological relationship.
policy.challenge_lab: Keep calculations, graph/data interpretation, experimental design, and unfamiliar transfer problems outside permanent loci as application tasks.
policy.scope_guard: Preserve misconception, terminology, and AP-scope boundaries as non-runtime support rather than memorization targets.
policy.review: Exact-name retrieval and mixed discrimination are specified now so later Review can sample across journeys without adding extra loci.
policy.spelling: No mandatory spelling gate in F2; spelling support remains adaptive.
